notes: Weights operate on min-max normalized metrics (0-1) across the candidate set actually available for a category. costEfficiency = 1 / blendedPrice1m, where blendedPrice1m assumes a 3:1 output:input token ratio (typical agentic coding workload) unless the category sets outputToInputRatio -- a documented simplification since Copilot (plan + credits) and OpenCode Go (flat $10/mo with per-model monthly caps) aren't priced the same way; per-token blended price is the common denominator we have. speed = performance.median_output_tokens_per_second from Artificial Analysis. topNPerProvider is the shortlist size within each individual provider -- there is no cross-provider ranking, since the choice is which provider's own lineup to use, not a mixed list.

agenticCoding.description: Left running for hours in a loop to solve a problem autonomously with minimal supervision (e.g. an OpenSpec/plan executor, a long-running coding agent).

codeReview.description: Reviewing code written by a different model, reasoning about correctness/design in context rather than driving tools itself.

softwareFactory.description: Executing well-scoped, already-planned coding tasks (e.g. from an OpenSpec change or a larger model's plan) -- throughput and cost matter more than raw intelligence.

llmWiki.description: Maintaining an LLM-curated markdown knowledge base (Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern): ingesting sources into many cross-linked pages, answering from the wiki with citations, and periodically linting it for contradictions, stale claims and orphan pages. Read-heavy and run repeatedly; faithfulness and synthesis matter more than coding skill.
llmWiki.notes: outputToInputRatio 0.2 (1 output token per 5 input tokens): each operation reads a source plus many existing pages and writes comparatively small edits. intelligenceIndex stands in for the signals that matter most here -- long-context reasoning, hallucination rate and instruction following -- which the free Artificial Analysis endpoint does not expose as separate scores. Context window size is not scored because no data source provides it.
